title: Wavelet Decomposition
caption: The 5-level db4 sub-bands of the first 6 seconds of D1_training-e_e02008 (PhysioNet 2016, 17.6 s). The y-axes are independent: sub-band amplitudes span three orders of magnitude and a shared scale would draw most of them as flat lines. Only cD1 lies wholly outside the 20-400 Hz passband, and it carries a median 0.2% of the decomposition energy across the corpus.
